name: send_rgb
notes: NOT in the send line (user decision). Before the f5 comparison (interview-evidence phase), set train.steps and model.relative_pos to the values in configs/send_pc.json (currently 10000 / true, and n_action_steps 2). f5 setup: the RGB branch uses Diffusion Policy's standard augmentation (random crop 96->88 per image in training, centre crop 88 at inference); the point cloud branch has no augmentation. Everything else (demos, diffusion head, pose + wrench conditioning, train section incl. steps) is identical in both configs. B5 timing was measured before the crop was added (96x96 input), so the RGB estimate is conservative.
